synopsis: Boliden is the mining company associated with Robotec.ai’s digital twin, also cited in the glossary as an example [f16087, f1086]. The twin supports autonomous fleet behaviour simulation and replay and is presented as vendor evidence for scene, machine-dynamics and sensor simulation [f1085, f400]. Robotec.ai reports 30% faster validation cycles for autonomous fleet behaviours; the corpus identifies this AWS-associated project as the only off-road simulation vendor speed-up claim found [f827, f481]. The claim was accessed in October 2026 but was not independently verified, so the reported improvement should be treated as a vendor claim rather than a validated outcome [f1086].
